vectors.description: Synthetic conformance vector pinning the gauge machine's bounds, clamping, and commit semantics (CROSS-18).
vectors.name: gauge bounds

steps.description: The lower bound never exceeds the upper bound (RNG-12 analogue; CROSS-18).
INPUT outside [min, max] clamps to the nearest bound (RNG-02 analogue; CROSS-19).
A release commits the current value (RNG-11 analogue; CROSS-06).
